g.text: Repeat the four-part CdSO4 dip, first rinse, Na2S dip and second rinse sequence to a
total of 10 cycles, as stated in the method and Figure 1b caption. This count
includes the first cycle above; it is not 10 additional cycles. Bath reuse or vessel
Rinse with water output; Cadmium sulfate SILAR bath; Aqueous sodium sulfide SILAR
CdSO4 → rinse → Na2S → rinse; 10 total cycles.
